pool.text: Find \( k \) so that \( f(x)=\begin{cases}kx+6 & x<2\\x^2+1 & x\ge 2\end{cases} \) is continuous at \( x = 2 \).
pool.sol: Match the one-sided limits at \( 2 \): \( 2 k + 6 = 5 \), so \( k = - \frac{1}{2} \).
